overview: Sales Kick-out clause in a commercial lease allows either the tenant or the landlord to terminate the lease early if the tenant’s gross sales fail to meet a specified dollar threshold within a set period. It acts as a safety net for retailers to exit underperforming locations or for landlords to replace low-performing tenants
